summary: Establish training habit from zero — all aerobic Z1-Z2, shoulder-safe strength introduction, six sessions in six days at controlled volume

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Aerobic base activation, establish Z2 feel on the bike

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, cadence 85-90 rpm, HR <145 bpm
Z2 steady aerobic, cadence 88-92 rpm, HR 146-162 bpm, conversational effort
Z1 easy spin down, HR below 130 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Shoulder-Safe
sessions.focus: Establish lower body movement patterns and core stability without shoulder loading
sessions.notes: 2 rounds, 60s rest between rounds: 10x Goblet Squat 16kg (3-sec descent), 10x Romanian Deadlift 16kg (hip hinge, neutral spine), 8x TRX Split Squat each leg (rear foot in strap), 15x Resistance Band Glute Bridge (band above knees, 1-sec squeeze at top), 8x Dead Bug each side (lower back flat to floor, no shoulder load). All upper body avoided due to shoulder injury. Progress to 22kg goblet squat and RDL in week 2 if movement quality is solid.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and lateral (10 each leg), hip circles, 10 slow bodyweight squats, 10 glute bridges
2 rounds: 10x Goblet Squat 16kg, 10x RDL 16kg, 8x TRX Split Squat/leg, 15x Band Glute Bridge, 8x Dead Bug/side. 60s rest between rounds.
Seated hamstring stretch 30s each leg, lying hip flexor stretch 30s each side, child's pose 30s

sessions.name: Aerobic Spin + Cadence Focus
sessions.focus: Aerobic continuity and neuromuscular efficiency through structured cadence variation

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 85 rpm, HR <145 bpm
Z2 aerobic block, HR 146-162 bpm. Cadence sequence: rep1=85rpm, rep2=90rpm, rep3=95rpm, rep4=88-90rpm. Power stays constant, only cadence changes.
Z1 easy spin between cadence blocks
Z2 steady at most comfortable cadence found in the blocks above, HR 146-162 bpm
Z1 easy spin down, HR below 130 bpm

sessions.name: Easy Z2 Run
sessions.focus: Introduce weekly running stimulus, aerobic base, HR compliance over pace

steps.description: Z1 walk/jog, HR <145 bpm. Walk first 2 min, then jog gently.
Z2 aerobic running, HR 146-162 bpm. If HR exceeds 162 bpm slow immediately — HR compliance trumps pace in week 1.
Z1 walk, HR below 120 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Active Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Flush Thursday run, promote recovery, maintain aerobic habit without adding load

steps.description: Z1 gentle spin, no resistance targets, HR <130 bpm
Z1 recovery ride, HR ceiling 140 bpm. Power ceiling 106W — if drifting above, back off. Cadence 85-90 rpm. This is blood-flow recovery, not training.
Wind down, free spin, minimal resistance

sessions.name: Base Endurance Ride
sessions.focus: Key aerobic base session — sustained Z2 to drive mitochondrial adaptation and fat oxidation

steps.description: Gradual build from 80W. Add small resistance every 2 min. By min 8 arrive at bottom of Z2. Cadence 85-90 rpm.
First 20 min of Z2 block — lower half of Z2, patient effort, HR 146-155 bpm, cadence 88-92 rpm
Second 20 min — allow natural drift to upper Z2, HR 155-162 bpm. Do not force. If HR exceeds 162 bpm, reduce power. Cadence 88-92 rpm.
Step-down cool-down: 8 min at 95W, then 4 min free spin. HR below 120 bpm at stop.

summary: Extend base aerobic volume — lengthen Saturday ride, add light sweet-spot taste mid-week on the bike, progress strength loads, run stays easy Z2

sessions.name: Aerobic Spin — Extended
sessions.focus: Z2 continuity, 5 min longer than week 1

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Progressive Load
sessions.focus: Increase to 22kg goblet/RDL, add single-leg work

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot Intro — 2x8min
sessions.focus: First taste of Z3 (142-168W), 2 reps only, build threshold ceiling

sessions.name: Easy Z2 Run
sessions.focus: Aerobic running continuity, same easy zone

sessions.name: Active Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Pre-Saturday flush

sessions.name: Base Endurance Ride — 50min Z2
sessions.focus: Extend Saturday anchor session by 10 minutes

summary: Shift into build — introduce proper threshold intervals on the bike (3x10min Z4), extend Saturday ride to 55-60min, running adds a short fartlek element

sessions.name: Z2 Aerobic Spin
sessions.focus: Aerobic maintenance, active recovery from week 2

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Strength Endurance
sessions.focus: 3 rounds, 22kg throughout, add banded lateral walks

sessions.name: Threshold Intervals 3x10min
sessions.focus: Z4 threshold work (169-195W), 3 reps x 10min, 5min recovery

sessions.name: Z2 Run + 3x1min Fartlek
sessions.focus: Aerobic base with brief neuromuscular stimulus, 3x1min at Z3 pace

sessions.name: Active Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Flush Thursday, protect Saturday quality

sessions.name: Build Endurance Ride — 55min
sessions.focus: Extend aerobic anchor session, last 10min drift to upper Z2

summary: Recovery week — drop volume ~40%, all intensity removed, easy Z1-Z2 only, let 3 weeks of adaptation consolidate before next block begins

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Z1 only, flush accumulated fatigue

sessions.name: Mobility & Light Core
sessions.focus: Reduced load — bodyweight only, focus on movement quality and shoulder mobility

sessions.name: Short Z2 Spin
sessions.focus: 20min Z2 maximum, feel the freshness returning

sessions.name: Easy 25min Z1-Z2 Run
sessions.focus: Keep the running habit, pure aerobic, no pressure

sessions.name: Easy Endurance Ride — 40min
sessions.focus: Shortened anchor ride, Z2 only, enjoy feeling recovered
